---
title: '03_estimation'
---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)

rm(list = ls())

options("scipen" = 100, "digits" = 4)

```

```{r}
estimate_wle <- function(data, states, ages, hours = F) {

table_wle <- data %>% mutate(outcome = ifelse(status %in% states, 1, 0))

if (length(states) == 1) table_wle <- table_wle %>% filter(!is.na(status))

table_wle <- table_wle %>%
  group_by(country, country_code, country_group, gender, cohort_two, age) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = sum(1 * weight, na.rm = T),
    Employed = sum(outcome * weight, na.rm = T),
    Contr = weighted.mean(outcome, na.rm = T),
    TotalVar = Total * Contr * (1 - Contr),
    Time = weighted.mean(working_hours_usual, na.rm = T),
    survival = mean(survival, na.rm = T),
    cohort = if (hours) min(cohort) else max(cohort)) %>%
  ungroup()

table_wle <- table_wle %>%
  mutate(Time = ifelse(is.na(Time), 0, Time),
         Time = ifelse(Time > 40, 1, Time / 40),
         Time = if (hours) Time else 1)

table_wle <- table_wle %>%
  mutate(Contr = ifelse(Total > 0, Employed / Total * Time * survival, 0),
         Sd1   = (Contr * (1 - Contr)) / TotalVar)

# projections for partially observed cohorts
table_wle <- table_wle %>%
  group_by(country, gender, cohort_two) %>%
  mutate(projected = 0) %>%
  complete(age = ages) %>%
  mutate(projected = ifelse(is.na(projected), 1, 0)) %>%
  arrange(country, gender, age, cohort_two) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cohort_two))

table_wle <- table_wle %>% group_by(country, gender) %>% fill(everything(), .direction = c("down"))

table_wle <- table_wle %>%
  group_by(country, country_code, country_group, gender, cohort_two) %>%
  mutate(WLE = sum(Contr), Var = sum(Sd1)) %>%
  filter(cohort == min(cohort)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(low = WLE - 1.96 * sqrt(Var), hig = WLE + 1.96 * sqrt(Var)) %>%
  select(country, country_code, country_group, gender, cohort_two, cohort, WLE, Var, low, hig, projected) %>%
  unique() %>%
  arrange(country, gender, cohort_two, projected)

return(table_wle)

}

estimate_all <- function(data, ages) {

wle <- estimate_wle(data, "Employed", ages) %>% mutate(var = "wle")
wle_adjusted <- estimate_wle(data, "Employed", ages, hours = T) %>% mutate(var = "wle_adjusted")
wyl_retirement <- estimate_wle(data, "Retired", ages) %>% mutate(var = "wyl_retirement")
wyl_unemployment <- estimate_wle(data, "Unemployed", ages) %>% mutate(var = "wyl_unemployment")
wyl_inactivity <- estimate_wle(data, c("Ill health", "Other"), ages) %>% mutate(var = "wyl_inactivity")

results <- rbind(wle, wle_adjusted, wyl_retirement, wyl_unemployment, wyl_inactivity)

results <- results %>% mutate(gender = if_else(gender == "Female population", "Women", "Men"))

return(results)

}

```

# Age group 55 to 64
```{r}
data <- readRDS("outputs/sample_55_64.rds")

results <- estimate_all(data, 55:64)

write.csv(results, "outputs/estimates_55_64.csv", row.names = F)

rm(data, results)

```

# Age group 65 to 74
```{r}
data <- readRDS("outputs/sample_65_74.rds")

results <- estimate_all(data, 65:74)

write.csv(results, "outputs/estimates_65_74.csv", row.names = F)

rm(data, results)

```
